append.description: If true, append output to the logfile instead of replacing it (-a).

cmd.description: The command to execute and log, including arguments.

logfile.description: The path to the logfile where the output will be saved.

skip_control_chars.description: If true, skip text bracketed by control-A and control-B (-s).

verbose.description: If true, make logsave more verbose in its output to the user (-v).
